items.title: Pay painting invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung auf unser Konto.
items.computation: The invoice carries no printed issue date (Rechnungsdatum), only the date the painting work was completed (12.08.2026). The 14-day payment period runs from the day the invoice is received ("nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung"), not from any date on the letter itself. No receipt date is stated and none can be inferred, so the count under § 187(1) BGB cannot be started and the final day cannot be fixed. If, for example, the invoice reached the recipient a few days after 12.08.2026 by post, the 14 days would run from that day (§§ 187, 188 BGB) and would fall on a Saturday/Sunday would shift to the next business day under § 193 BGB — but this is only illustrative; the actual due date needs the real receipt date.

warnings: The invoice has no printed issue date (Rechnungsdatum), and the payment period runs from receipt ("nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung") rather than from a fixed date, so the exact due date cannot be computed without knowing the day the invoice actually arrived — please check the envelope or email date it was received and count 14 days from there.
Verify the IBAN (DE10 3705 0198 0001 2345 60) against a previous, independently obtained document from this same painting company before paying, as a general precaution when transferring money.
